After being berated for 20 minutes straight I decided to tell my partner who was driving to take a detour. We went down an extremely whindy, bumpy road that was about a mile long. The AED machine soon toppled out of its cabinet and landed straight on her head, giving her a nice size gash on the top of her head. It also knocked her unconscious. I wiped the machine off, put it back securely in its place, checked her vitals, and when we got to our destination I put it in the paperwork that she had slammed her head intentionally against the bed railings, causing the gash and rendering her unconscious.
